authorized_changes_only: Replace unconditional Home Assistant loader.async_setup invocation with a prospectively frozen API-surface adapter executed before any E0Q case: if DATA_INTEGRATIONS is absent and loader.async_setup exists, call it; if the API does not exist, do not call it and use the runtime's native lazy async_get_integration/async_get_integrations path.
Decorate state_changed and call_service observer handlers with the Home Assistant core @callback marker so they remain on the Home Assistant event-loop callback path instead of executor scheduling.
Add an observer-local strictly increasing event sequence number to every captured state and service event.
Add an explicit capture-epoch certificate containing armed_ns, state_start_index, service_start_index, and next_sequence_at_arm before each invocation.

Strengthen positive ordering validation to require both parent and qualifying service event to belong to the armed epoch, parent sequence < service sequence, parent perf_counter_ns <= service perf_counter_ns, and both to close no later than the same completion boundary.

Strengthen verified-absence validation to require an armed epoch, exactly one matching parent event after arming, zero qualifying service events for the invocation context after arming, and a valid three-pass completion closure after the parent.

Record phase-tagged partial diagnostic evidence on harness failure so a future failed qualification can distinguish loader, capture, ordering, and validation failures without adaptive retry or reinterpretation.

loader_adapter_law.predicate: DATA_INTEGRATIONS membership and presence of callable loader.async_setup only
loader_adapter_law.modern_path: if DATA_INTEGRATIONS absent and callable loader.async_setup exists, call loader.async_setup(hass)
loader_adapter_law.legacy_path: if DATA_INTEGRATIONS absent and loader.async_setup does not exist, make no synthetic loader-state mutation; call async_get_integration and allow the runtime's native lazy loader path to initialize itself

forbidden_changes: change any Better Thermostat source commit, source tree identity, manifest identity, Home Assistant version, or OCI digest
carry T02_NEW v1 PASS into v2 or skip any role
weaken exactly-one positive cardinality or zero-event absence cardinality
remove context binding, three-pass completion, or negative fail-closed tests
mount or execute a T01/T02 result-bearing blueprint, state manifest, frontier label, or historical action
introduce timeouts as sufficient evidence of absence
add result-dependent retries, fallback adapters, or per-role post-hoc special cases
next_gate: Build a minimal public v2 successor from the sealed v1 failure, prove the code delta is limited to the authorized loader/observer/diagnostic remediation while all scientific and substrate inputs remain unchanged, then open one fresh four-role E0Q-v2 authority.
